title: Native delivery run: stream the real padded system.apfs from the host over bulk-OUT into the 4908 MiB window, boot the payload kernel with md0 on it, PID 1 hashes the device; first measured host-to-device rate and first full-size root in RAM
acceptance: One run under its own decision file; the phone is restored from the pinned stock by NAT-013; Android and data checked afterwards.

Reported separately: bytes and seconds received by the device and by the host (rate), rx_errors, PID 1's digest against the image's SHA-256, kernel page size and free pages after md0, and the ending (cap reset to Download Mode or not).
A digest mismatch, a short transfer or a SEC_UPLOAD ending is recorded as the finding with the numbers, not as a pass.
